title: Codec port labels
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean alphabet, the codec ports consist of labels for the state, input head, and input symbol; for each work tape, a head label and two symbol labels, one for each Boolean value; two summary labels, one for each Boolean value; and labels for the old and new bits.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
